newsitem.title: USA: Northwest Natgas files for Ore. rate cut.
newsitem.headline: Northwest Natgas files for Ore. rate cut.

text.p: Northwest Natural Gas Co. filed for a rate reduction of 3 percent for its Oregon residential customers, effective from December 1, 1996, the utility said Thursday.
If approved, this would be the fifth consecutive rate reduction by Northwest Natural Gas in the last three years.

The reduction includes the effects of lower gas costs from the company's suppliers for the coming year. It also includes amounts to be refunded over the next 12 months for gas cost savings, Ballot Measure 5 property tax savings and Oregon "tax kicker" savings realized in prior years.

The utility said the change will have no effect on company earnings. The proposed reductions, which require approval of the Oregon Public Utility Commission, amount to 3.9 percent for commercial customers, 4.4 percent for industrial firm customers and 6.4 percent for interruptible customers.
Northwest Natural Gas serves about 392,000 customers in its Oregon service territory.
